svg.title: NovaVision pipeline, mobile layout
svg.desc: The app follows four steps: write text, analyze text, build a prompt, and render an image. It returns the image, prompt, and run details. Separate experiments set known emotion and affect targets, reuse prompt building and rendering for raw, naive, emotion, and affect tiers with the same requested seed and settings, then compare image-probe estimates with the targets. The app defaults to synthetic test images. Probe outputs are model estimates, not human ratings; they do not feed back into generation.
